"Her Majesty" | | | | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+ | | +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+ "Polythene Pam" is a song written by John Lennon, credited to Lennon-McCartney, and performed by the Beatles on their album Abbey Road. The song is the part of the B-side medley in which Lennon declares that the title heroine "is so good looking but she looks like a man." ©1969 Sony/ATV Music Publishing LLC. All rights reserved.
